stack_matrix.provider: rustls-graviola 0.2.1, existing pure-Rust provider; ring/aws-lc disabled

name: tonic-pbrs
description: Same-codec transport reference: tonic 0.14 transport with the pbrs codec (rpc-bench --transport=tonic); isolates transport deltas from serialization

upstream_pin.notes: Exact versions resolved in tests/interop/tonic/Cargo.lock; build with --locked. Transport only; the codec is the in-tree pbrs engine.

server.description: Tonic benchmark server with native-matched transport settings (from rpc-bench fair_tonic_server)

transport_contract.mechanism: rpc-bench fair_tonic_server: 16 MiB windows, 1 MiB frames, 256 streams, TCP_NODELAY on with getsockopt verification (NodelayIncoming); identical contract to the native peer

client.description: Tonic benchmark client with native-matched transport settings (from rpc-bench fair_tonic_endpoint)

matching_configuration.cores: matched pinned cores; effective quota recorded per run
matching_configuration.http2_windows: 16 MiB stream/connection windows, 1 MiB frames, 256 max streams, 16 KiB header list, adaptive window off (native-matched)
matching_configuration.message_limits: 4 MiB worker body cap; receiving-peer protobuf overhead counted
matching_configuration.handler_work: identical TestService/BenchmarkService procedures and validation on every peer

tls.reason: Legacy server/client adapter is plaintext-only. stack-matrix load-server/load supports verified tonic TLS via Graviola; see stack_matrix.
